reason: `canary history record` (#538) plus ADR 0013 (#390): module-size 28634->29130 (+496). Measured on this tree, and attributed EMPIRICALLY rather than arithmetically, the same way #686's allowance was: reverting ts/src/history/cli.ts to origin/main, moving ts/src/history/run-recorder.ts aside, and restoring scripts/dogfood-record-run.mjs drops `harness check-arch --json` regressions to [] with totalViolations unchanged at 21 -- so the whole +496 is those two source files and nothing else in the change contributes. The rest of the diff is CHANGELOG.md, ADR 0013, AGENTS.md, README.md, two entryPoints entries, dogfood.yml, and two test files (ts/test/history-record.test.ts, ts/test/gate-conformance.test.ts) -- module-size does not count test code. Note the arrow: 28634 is main's ALLOWED absolute from #686's allowance, not the baselineValue 26965 that check-arch prints, and per #689 the printed arrow must never be read as this change's delta. What the 496 lines buy: the history store had no writer at all. `canary analyze` and `canary history` have always read test-results/reports/history-v2.jsonl, and the only thing that ever wrote it was scripts/dogfood-record-run.mjs -- 125 lines of CI glue in this repo, now deleted -- so the entire read surface, including the runs-vs-rows denominator design from #508 whose whole purpose is telling a healthy fleet from an empty one, had only ever been exercised against synthetic fixtures. The new code is deliberately more than a port of the script it replaces, and every increment is a refusal to lie: a zero-result report abstains with exit 3 instead of appending a 0/0 run (with a conformance-registry row); an unrecognized report shape is refused by name instead of read as zero tests; a duplicate run_id exits 1 instead of relying on the store's silent idempotent skip, and degrades to a `could not be verified` note on a backend with no countRuns(); --repo is inferred or exits 2 instead of defaulting to a hardcoded slug; and validateBuiltRun checks the record through the store's own serializer before the append, because a malformed line degrades every later read of the file rather than failing locally. Splitting differently would not help -- module-size is a repo-wide aggregate, so the conversion half (run-recorder.ts, 243 lines, already extracted from the CLI so it is unit-testable without a store) and the CLI half score identically whether they are one file or two, and both sit well under the per-file thresholds. Nothing was absorbed here to avoid a fix: newViolations is 0 and the pre-existing violations stay at 21. The one new per-function complexity warning this change first produced (recordContext at 13, threshold 10) was FIXED rather than allowanced, by extracting resolveRepo and routing the env fallbacks through util/coalesce's def() -- re-measured at 0 new violations afterwards. REBASED onto 45d16b4 (#699 merged mid-change): re-measured after the rebase and the absolute is unchanged at 29130 with regressions back to [] once this file is present, so #699 moved no module-size -- the number here is the post-rebase measurement, not the pre-rebase one carried forward.
